senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. חבב a. אבק)to embrace, press, fasten. Part. pass. חָבוּק, pl. חֲבוּקִין clinging to, creeping (of vines).
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 6:1:4">Y. Kil. VI, beg., 30ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ לכותל</he> creeping up the wall.
<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 3:1">Pesik. R. s. 3</cite> <he>באין ומְחַבְּקִין וכ׳</he> they shall come and embrace Rachel’s grave; a. fr.

senses.gloss: to embrace one another, make love. Y. Bets. II, 61ᶜ מִתְחַבֵּק עם וכ׳ making love to thy wife; Y. Sabb. II, 6ᵃ bot. מְחַבֵּק.
